From Man in the Mirror · Price: you need a mirror or reflective surface.

Theme Mind and Sense

  • 1: 1 action: send your stand into a mirror; it can see the mirror world and move through it. 1 action: your stand reaches out of a reflection at a creature within 30 ft: @Damage[(1+floor((@actor.level - 1)/4))d6[bludgeoning]] (@Check[reflex|against:stand|basic]{basic Reflex}); on a failure it's @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.kWc1fhmv9LBiTuei]{grabbed} at and @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.AJh5ex99aV6VTggg]{off-guard} until the start of your next turn; on a critical failure it's half-dragged into the glass: @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.AJh5ex99aV6VTggg]{off-guard} for 1 minute and @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.eIcWbB5o3pP6OIMe]{immobilized} for 1 round.
  • 5: Surge: pull a creature within 30 ft of the mirror into the mirror world, the glass cutting it as it passes: @Damage[(1+floor((@actor.level - 1)/4))d6[slashing]] (@Check[will|against:stand|basic]{basic Will}); on a failure it's in the mirror world for 1 round (2 rounds on a critical failure): it can't affect anyone outside, but your stand can attack it.
  • 9: You can choose what comes with the creature into the mirror (its weapons stay outside).
  • 13: You can bring allies in. The surge can pull in two creatures.
  • 17: A creature in the mirror world takes –2 to all checks against your stand.

Defaults: Stand, Occult and Concentrate traits; a surge costs 1 Stand Point and 2 actions unless listed; ranges are measured from your stand; untyped damage is force; saves use your stand DC. A minion an ability makes, unless it says otherwise, is a creature of your level – 2 built with GM Core's Low numbers (Building Creatures), with the minion trait.
